title: PAVOQUE Corpus of Expressive Speech
scope: non-singing spoken utterances with manually corrected phonetic segments
manual_evidence: Repository documentation states that YAML utterances contain optionally manually corrected phonetic segments; each segment carries a SAMPA-based label and end time. Public YAML directly exposes utterance text, style, utterance start/end, and corrected segment sequences.
lineage_notes: Primary studio expressive-speech recordings from one native German professional actor. Speaker's opera-singer profession does not make these spoken recordings singing; corpus styles are spoken expressive conditions. Treat all style YAMLs as one recording lineage.
